mask.method: ImageGen original person-to-white in original room, then environment-to-black preserving that source silhouette; original mother RGB renders through native luminance mask.

shadow.order: matching background, low-opacity dark contact mask, original mother RGB through figure mask

foreground.reason: This fixed source pose places visible girl, held book, supporting palm and shoes in front of room-owned support surfaces. Bench, pillows, blanket, desk book, mug and lamp remain in matching background.

provisionalCalibration.maskBoundsMethod: Read-only luminance >32/255 measurement of this exact generated figure mask; right/bottom exclusive. No bitmap edits. Very faint antialias values may extend beyond practical visible bounds.
provisionalCalibration.anchorMethod: Approximate hip-seat, lowest shoe-floor and interaction contour visually traced from this exact weather source/mask, not inherited from an old large character. Scene owner validates integrated Stage metadata.
provisionalCalibration.scope: Original source position only; no translation/motion/anchor transition claim.

productionNotes.rejectionReason: v1 retained navy outer skirt tips; v2 restarted from approved complete mother and filled the full source fabric. Rejected v1 never used downstream.
